mapper.insert: insert into flow_delegate ( instance_id, task_id, task_name, from_id, from_name, to_id, to_name, comment, create_time ) values ( #{instanceId}, #{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{fromId}, #{fromName}, #{toId}, #{toName}, #{comment}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select delegate_id, instance_id, task_id, task_name, from_id, from_name, to_id, to_name, comment, create_time from flow_delegate where instance_id = #{instanceId} order by create_time asc, delegate_id asc
select delegate_id, instance_id, task_id, task_name, from_id, from_name, to_id, to_name, comment, create_time from flow_delegate where from_id = #{fromId} order by create_time desc, delegate_id desc
